name: Remote tunnel
author: Rigbay contributors
description: Turns WireGuard tunnels on and off from Rigbay (page, tray, shortcut, command line) and shows their status.

network: reads the addresses of the tunnel adapter and the local TCP listeners (only for the optional local-service check); nothing is sent
services: WireGuardTunnel$<name>: installed and removed through wireguard.exe, start type changed (only when you ask)
